newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Tuesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady in light test.

Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 300 head slaughter steers and 800 head heifers; 21,800 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 10,800 head of formulated cattle and 100 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week and 1,500 head or 41 loads of CME cattle delivered to area packing plants.
Slaughter Steers: Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 71.00. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 70.00.
Slaughter Heifers: Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 71.00, Pen North Plains 72.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 70.00.
Wk to date: 21,800 Week Ago: 58,300 Year Ago: 16,600
